motivation: The official orthography makes ę optional, permits basic spelling by omitting its diacritic, and discourages the extended alphabet for ordinary reader-facing use without a special purpose. Earlier project decisions explicitly define najčestěje and pytanje as project/basic spellings. The live family census is 156 tokens, with 144 already nonnasal and only 12 nasalized. The four wrapper headings were introduced by EDIT-0003 and EDIT-0006 through circular reliance on the newly changed Part-III wrapper rather than an independently established house policy.
